name: Branzino
siboNotes: Plain fish is naturally FODMAP-free and well-tolerated in SIBO protocols. Avoid high-FODMAP seasonings or marinades.
preparationTips: Season with FODMAP-friendly herbs like basil, oregano, or rosemary
Use garlic-infused oil instead of fresh garlic for flavor
Grill, bake, or pan-sear with olive oil and lemon
Avoid breading with wheat flour; use rice flour if needed
